summary:
FMLink promotes NFMT West, the National Facilities Management & Technology Conference & Expo West, taking place in Las Vegas on November 3-4 at the Horseshoe Event Center. The event is positioned as a sibling to NFMT East in Baltimore and is pitched at facility management teams attending together for two days of education, networking, and vendor discovery.

The piece describes the scale of the event as dozens of expert-led sessions, hundreds of exhibitors, and thousands of FM decision-makers under one roof. Education programming is led by practitioners and framed around day-to-day operational challenges. All conference sessions qualify for continuing education credits (CEUs), with NFMT handling registration, scheduling, and certificate delivery.

Five session tracks are listed: The Digital Evolution; People & Performance; Tech & Market Trends; Safe, Sound and Healthy; and Efficiency/Optimization.

The Expo Hall is presented as a place to evaluate building operations technology, compare solutions side by side, and speak with manufacturers. Expo features include hundreds of exhibitors across FM categories, live demos and hands-on product evaluations, prize giveaways across both days, and free admission with event registration.

The article advises teams to either attend sessions together or split up to cover more topics and reconvene to share learnings, and to divide and conquer on the expo floor. Networking is highlighted, including an Opening Night Poker Party.

Group registration rules are spelled out: all attendees must be from the same company, all must register for ALL ACCESS, a designated Group Contact must register everyone at the same time, all group attendees must be registered with the same credit card, and each attendee receives an individual email confirmation.

The item is essentially event marketing rather than analysis, with no data, research findings, or named sources beyond the organizer. Readers are directed to the NFMT West site for details.
